models.name: RCE-BL15X
models.firmware_note: Integrated BEC adjustable 5.0 V (default), 5.5 V, 6.0 V; the BEC type is stated on a third-party page, not by Align
models.spec_source: https://www.hobbyhangar.co.nz/kx880003a-15a-brushless-escgoverner-mode-rce-bl15x (dealer quoting Align: input 5.5-12.6 V, Li-Po 2-3 cells, 15 A continuous); the Align manual scans in Align_RCE-BL15X_kestral.html give no voltage

automatable_note: The only source is a third-party web page that shows one worked example. The audible patterns and the option lists are in image files that are not in the archive.

entry.confirm_signal: Two buzzing groups: group 1 after the battery connects, group 2 after the stick moves to low.
steps: Battery disconnected, radio in normal mode, no throttle hold, stick at 100%.
Connect the battery: ESC enters programming; buzzing group 1; leave the stick at 100% (high-stick calibration).
Move the stick to 0%: buzzing group 2 (low-stick calibration).
Run through the steps: each step answers by low, mid or high position.

announce.description: Each programming step is announced as a buzzing pattern from the motor (image in the source, not readable). The motor must be connected on all three leads.

select.description: The source shows steps answered at 0% (low), 20% stick giving 50% command (mid) and 100% (high).

scheme.confirm_signal: Buzzing pattern per step (not described in text).
scheme.exit: With the stick at 0% power cycle the battery, then listen to the status beeps to verify.
scheme.description: Stick at 100% when the battery connects. The ESC calibrates high stick, then low stick when the stick moves to 0%. Then six steps run; each is answered with the low, mid or high stick position. The page records one worked example, not the option lists.

values.name: disabled (low stick) in the author's example
mid-range timing (mid stick) in the author's example
high cutoff protection (low stick) in the author's example
helicopter mode with soft start (mid stick) in the author's example
standard (low stick) in the author's example
6 V (high stick) in the author's example

unknowns: All other option values for every step: the Align user manual pages are images not present in the archive.
Stick-position numbering (low = 1, mid = 2, high = 3) is the schema's convention; the page does not number options.
Beep or buzz durations: not stated; the audible feedback column is images.
Mid stick position: the page says mid is stick at about 20% giving a 50% command only under the author's throttle curve (normal mode), not a manual value.
Hold times between steps: not stated.
Default value of each item: not stated except BEC 5.0 V.
Cell count, voltage limits: not stated.
Whether step 3 in the table (listed twice) is the item after calibration: the table numbers calibration as step 3 and the first item also as 3.
notes: The table in the source numbers items 3 to 8 and repeats 3 for both the calibration move and the brake step; item numbers here follow the order of the six programming rows.
Align's own manual could not be fetched (TLS failure) and was replaced by this third-party page according to INDEX.csv.
